gizmo.title: Pātai tau
gizmo.description: He pātai e whakautua ana ki tētahi tau. Ko te whakautu he tau pūmau, he tātai rānei ka tātaihia mai i ngā taurangi, ā, ka whakaaetia mēnā kei roto i te āwhanga.

configure.title: Pātai
configure.description: Te mea e pātaihia ana ki ngā ākonga. Tuhia te ingoa o tētahi taurangi ki roto i ngā taiapa kōrua, pērā i {d}, hei whakaatu i tōna uara.

configure.title: Waeine
configure.description: Ka whakaaturia hei kuputuhi i te taha o te āpure whakautu, hei tauira km/h.

configure.title: Whakautu
configure.description: Te tau tika. Waiho kia wātea mēnā mā tētahi tātai e tātai te whakautu.

configure.title: Tātai
configure.description: Ka tātai i te whakautu mai i ngā taurangi, hei tauira d / (t / 60). Ka taea te whakamahi i te + - * / ^, ngā taiapa, sqrt() me abs(). Ka whakamahia hei whakakapi i te whakautu ina tautuhia.

configure.title: Ngā taurangi
configure.description: Ngā tau e whakamahia ana e te tātai me te pātai. Ka whiwhi ia mea i tētahi uara i waenga i tōna iti rawa me tōna teitei rawa, ā-hipanga.

advanced.title: Āwhanga
advanced.description: Te tawhiti mai i te whakautu tika e whakaaetia tonu ana. Ko te 0 te tikanga he tika rawa, kua whakaawhiwhia rānei ki ngā ira ā-ira i raro.

advanced.title: Momo āwhanga
advanced.description: Pūmau: tāpiri, tango rānei i te āwhanga. Ōrau: tāpiri, tango rānei i taua ōrau o te whakautu tika.

advanced.title: Ngā ira ā-ira
advanced.description: Ka tonoa ngā ākonga kia whakaawhiwhia ki tēnei maha o ngā ira, ā, ka whakaaturia te whakautu kua whakaawhiwhia. Waiho kia wātea mō te kore whakaawhiwhi.

advanced.title: Ngā ngana
advanced.description: E hia ngā wā ka taea e te ākonga te arowhai. Ko te 0 te tikanga kāore he tepe.

advanced.title: He tau hou i ia ngana
advanced.description: Tōia he uara taurangi hou ia wā ka ngana anō tētahi ākonga. Kāore tā rātou whakautu o mua e whakaaturia ina hoki mai, ko te mea anake mēnā i tika.

advanced.title: Ka taea te kōpaki
advanced.description: Whakaaturia tēnei pātai hei rārangi ka tuwhera, ka kati hoki. Ka kati te whakatuwhera i tētahi i ētahi atu pātai kōpaki i tōna taha.

advanced.title: Tīmata kua kōpakina
advanced.description: Ina taea te kōpaki, tīmata hei rārangi kua kati e whakaatu ana i te pātai me tōna tūnga anake.

developer.title: Ingoa o te pātaitai
developer.description: Te ingoa pātaitai e whakamahia ana mō te tautohu xAPI i ngā pūnaha tātari.
